usageDashboard.title: Artemis in numbers
usageDashboard.subtitle: Anonymous, aggregated usage of this Artemis instance during the last four semesters.
usageDashboard.error: The usage numbers could not be loaded. Please try again later.
usageDashboard.empty: There are not enough courses yet to show usage numbers.

hints.courses: Courses that are no test course, have at least 5 students and start in the semester.
hints.students: Unique people enrolled as student in at least one of these courses.
hints.enrollments: Not unique: a student of three of these courses is counted three times.
hints.competencies: Competencies of these courses, without prerequisites. Only shown if the instance offers competencies.
hints.tutorialGroups: Tutorial groups of these courses, whenever they took place.
hints.exercises: Exercises of these courses, including exam exercises.
hints.activeStudents: Counted students who made at least one submission in an exercise or exam of these courses.
hints.submissions: Submissions of the counted students and their teams, whenever they were made.
hints.builds: Finished builds, whenever they ran. Only shown if the instance builds with local CI. Build jobs are deleted after one year by default.
hints.averageBuildDuration: Average duration of the successful builds.
hints.exams: Real exams of these courses. Test exams, and exams whose title starts with "test" or "mock", are not counted. Only shown if the instance offers exams.
hints.examRegistrations: Not unique: a student registered for three of these exams is counted three times.
hints.communication: Totals over the courses of the semester, including what tutors, instructors and the system did. Posts include channels, group chats and direct messages.

usageDashboard.footer: Only totals are shown, never single courses or people, and semesters with fewer than 3 counted courses are hidden. The numbers are refreshed about once per hour.
